kzchangerequest: Dialog title for the change request form.
kzchangerequest-intro-1: Heading shown at the top of the change request form.
kzchangerequest-intro-2: Introductory text shown below the main form heading.
kzchangerequest-relevantpage: Label for the page the request refers to.
kzchangerequest-pageunknown: Fallback page title when the relevant page is unknown.
kzchangerequest-request: Label and placeholder for the request details field.
kzchangerequest-contact-intro-1: Heading for the optional contact details section.
kzchangerequest-contact-intro-2: Helper text shown below the contact details heading.
kzchangerequest-contact-email: Label for the contact email field.
kzchangerequest-contact-name: Label for the contact name field.
kzchangerequest-notice: Notice shown below the form fields explaining the scope of support.
kzchangerequest-submit: Label for the form submission button.
kzchangerequest-cancel: Label for cancel and close buttons in the dialog.
kzchangerequest-waiting: Progress message shown while a request is being processed.
kzchangerequest-finish: Label for the final action after a successful submission.
kzchangerequest-submission-error: Error shown when the request cannot be submitted because of an internal problem.
kzchangerequest-captcha-fail: Error shown when CAPTCHA verification fails.
kzchangerequest-confirmation-message: Success message shown after a request is submitted.
kzchangerequest-modal-load-error: Error shown when the change request dialog cannot be opened.
kzchangerequest-button-label: Label for buttons or links that open the change request dialog.
kzchangerequest-recaptcha-load-error: Error shown when the reCAPTCHA client cannot be loaded.
kzchangerequest-fallback-message: Lead-in text before the fallback contact email link.
kzchangerequest-fallback-email-title: Email subject used for the fallback mailto link. Parameters: $1 - page title.
kzchangerequest-fallback-email-body: Default body text used in the fallback mailto link.
